purpose: Audit of the frozen C0 (rasterize_gaussian_higs_dynamic, TILE_SIZE=16) forward/backward raster inner loop, required BEFORE writing any QSCAN CUDA (protocol section 2). Gates P18_MAPPING_BLOCKER.
verdict: MAPPING_OK — a contiguous subgroup's lanes process the SAME Gaussian on the SAME image row per raster loop iteration; QSCAN subwarp 4/8/16 is feasible in both forward and backward. P18_MAPPING_BLOCKER not triggered.

forward.conic_storage: half2[2] in smem (smem_conic_raw), = raw covar2d_inv * CHOL_SCALE^2 with -log2(opac) fused into the c11 slot
expressions: u0_base = l00 * dx                       (line 308, dx = mean_x - offset_x, lane-varying in x)
u0 = l10 * dy + u0_base                  (line 314, per pixel-pair pp)
u1 = l11 * dy                            (line 315, per pixel-pair pp)
forward.note: alpha = exp2(-sigma); since sigma = a x^2 + b x + c with a=(0.5)*CHOL^2*c00 in x (dy,u1 constant across the row's lanes), alpha(x) = G(x) = exp2(-(a x^2 + b x + c)) = exp(q(x)). G0 = exp2(-(a x0^2+b x0+c)). r_j = G(x_{j+1})/G(x_j). k = G(x_{j+2})/(G(x_{j+1})^2/G(x_j)) = exp2(-dd) where dd = 2a (constant) == exp(dd) in natural domain per protocol section 3.

backward.conic_storage: raw vec3 = covar2d_inv (NOT CHOL-scaled), [I*N,3], forward-captured from the gatherless producer (GatherlessProjectedProducer.cu line 100: conics = covar2d_inv upper triangle)
backward.note: Gaussian weight is RECOMPUTED in backward (not stored from forward). P18 backward MUST recompute via QSCAN (protocol forbids storing all Gaussian-pixel weights in HBM). The forward conic (CHOL-scaled, half) and backward conic (raw, float) are related by the constant CHOL_SCALE^2; each is a 1-D quadratic in x along a fixed row, so the same QSCAN machinery (seeds G0,r0,k + multiplicative prefix scan) applies to both, with per-kernel exp semantics (exp2f/half for forward, expf/float for backward).

actual_exp_intrinsic_function.forward: __h2exp2_approx (half exp2) on -sigma; equivalent to exp2f under -use_fast_math. QSCAN forward seeds MUST use __h2exp2_approx / exp2f (same fast-math exp2).
actual_exp_intrinsic_function.backward: __expf (float exp, fast-math). QSCAN backward seeds MUST use __expf.
actual_exp_intrinsic_function.build_flag_note: c0_ext built with -use_fast_math (build.ninja), so both expf and exp2f take the fast (approximate) path. Using the same intrinsic for seeds keeps seed semantics identical to baseline per protocol section 3.

alpha_cull_threshold.ALPHA_THRESHOLD: 1/255 (Common.h:97) — the semantics-changing per-pixel branch: forward ok_mask = sigma < log2(1/AT) = log2(255)=7.9943534 (LOG2_INV_AT, line 83); backward valid = !(sigma<0 || alpha<AT).
alpha_cull_threshold.MAX_ALPHA: 0.99 (Common.h:105) — clamp on opac*vis in backward alpha (forward relies on exp2 underflow to 0, no explicit clamp).
alpha_cull_threshold.MIN_TRANSPARENCY: 1e-4 (MacroTileRasterize.cu:85) / TRANSMITTANCE_THRESHOLD 1e-4 (Common.h:106) — warp-wide early-exit on transmittance T, NOT a per-pixel alpha branch; P18 must preserve it unchanged.
alpha_cull_threshold.gamma: 2e-6 (protocol fixed) — if QSCAN alpha is within gamma of a branch threshold (AT=1/255, or the sigma<0 / MAX_ALPHA=0.99 backward bounds), that lane falls back to the DIRECT Gaussian expression and re-decides the branch. gamma=0 only as supplementary sensitivity.

tile_size: 16 (trainer publication_trainer_p12.py lines 380, 741-744; default rasterize_gaussian_higs_dynamic tile_size=16 line 3002). MACRO_TILE = FUSED_MACRO_TILE_WIDTH*HEIGHT = 8*4 = 32 tiles. FUSED_GAUSS_BATCH_SIZE = 1024. MINI_BATCH = 32.

forward.mapping: thread_x = lane_id & 15, thread_y = lane_id >> 4 (lines 273-274). Each lane owns 8 contiguous x-pixels in ONE row: pairs pp=0..3 at rows thread_y + 2*pp, x = thread_x + 2*pp and thread_x + 2*pp+1.
forward.row_structure: For a fixed gaussian + fixed row: lanes 0..15 cover x=0..31 (the whole 32-wide row), each lane handling 2 x-pixels (a pair). Thus the 32 lanes of a warp are 32 CONTIGUOUS x-pixels of the same row (x = 2*lane_in_half .. x = 2*lane_in_half+1, lane_in_half = lane & 15, duplicated to 32 via the 2-pair-per-lane unroll). q(x) is a 1-D quadratic in x; dy, u1, u0_base are lane-invariant.

backward.mapping: i = i0 + ty + q*PX_ROWS, j = j0 + tx (lines 397-398), q in {0,1}, ty = thread_index.y, tx = thread_index.x. A warp = 16 x-columns (tx) x 2 y-rows (ty); each lane owns 2 pixels (same tx, rows ty and ty+8). For a fixed row, 16 contiguous lanes cover 16 x-pixels => q(x) is again a 1-D quadratic in x.
backward.note: Backward processes 16 x-lanes per row (not 32). QSCAN16 in backward = the 16 x-lanes of one row; QSCAN8/4 are subgroups. The same row-structure argument holds.

warp_to_row_mapping.forward: Within one raster loop iteration for one tile, all warps rasterize the SAME tile; each warp handles ALL 32 x-pixels of each of the tile's rows across its 8 pairs. One warp iteration over a gaussian = the whole row set of one tile. The relevant 'subgroup processes the same Gaussian' unit is the 16-lane half that covers one row's 32 x-pixels (or the full 32 lanes over the two row-pairs).
warp_to_row_mapping.backward: Each block covers one tile; a warp's 16 x-lanes x 2 y-rows cover 32 pixels (16x2). For a given row, the 16 x-lanes share the Gaussian.

shared_gaussian_load_path.forward: Phase 1: each warp loads a 32-gaussian mini-batch from global (means2d, conics) into persistent smem (smem_xy_mt, smem_conic_raw), computes per-tile visibility masks via a 5-stage warp bit-transpose (WarpBitTranspose, line 90) into smem_masks. Phase 2 (rasterization): per-tile, a ring-buffer (smem_warp_queue, 128 entries) streams gaussian indices; the warp drains in 64-entry batches, unrolled x8, calling rasterizeGaussian which reads gaussian data from smem (1 smem load per gaussian, invariant across the 4 pairs). => smem holds gaussian data cooperatively; rasterization reads it per gaussian. QSCAN can compute k=exp2(-dd) ONCE per gaussian (in the per-gaussian setup before the N_PAIRS loop) and broadcast via shuffle.
shared_gaussian_load_path.backward: Per-batch, each thread fetches 1 gaussian (id, xy, opac, conic, rgb) into smem (id_batch, xy_opacity_batch, conic_batch, rgbs_batch); block.sync; then the warp iterates t over the batch, reading conic_batch[t]/xy_opacity_batch[t] from smem. => smem cooperatively holds the gaussian batch; the warp processes each gaussian t across its 16 x-lanes. QSCAN can compute seeds + k per (gaussian t, row) in the per-t loop.

backward_gaussian_weight_path.recompute: YES — eval_gaussian_weight(conic, dx, dy, opac) is called per (lane, q-pixel, gaussian t) in the t-loop (line 489). The forward weight is NOT stored/reused; backward recomputes from forward-captured conics+means2d+opacities+colors_eval.
backward_gaussian_weight_path.P18_implication: QSCAN must replace this per-pixel __expf(-sigma) with seed+prefix-scan reconstruction in the t-loop, with the same gamma guard on the valid branch. The downstream v_sigma = -opac*vis*v_alpha chain (SCALAR_ADJOINT/H8_MR) is unchanged; only vis/alpha change source.

P18_MAPPING_BLOCKER.reason: In both forward (TILE_SIZE=16, GAUSS_PER_WARP=1) and backward (PX=2), the lanes of a contiguous subgroup (16/8/4) that share a row process the SAME Gaussian at the SAME raster loop iteration, over CONTIGUOUS x-pixels. q(x) is a 1-D quadratic in x, so the quotient reconstruction G_j = G0 * prod_{t<j} r_t (r_t = G(x_{t+1})/G(x_t), k = G(x_{t+2})/(G(x_{t+1})/G(x_t)) = exp(-dd), dd=2a) applies directly across the subwarp. No rasterizer redesign is required — only the per-pixel exp is replaced by seed + warp/subwarp exclusive multiplicative prefix scan, preserving pixel parallelism (no lane-0 serial walk).
caveats: Forward row structure: 32 lanes = 32 contiguous x-pixels (2 per lane). QSCAN16 = lanes [16k..16k+15] (one x-run of 16 pixels) or the 16-lane half covering 32 x-pixels — choose the mapping that keeps each QSCAN group on one contiguous x-run of the same row.
The forward exp is half exp2 (__h2exp2_approx) and the backward exp is float exp (__expf); each QSCAN kernel must use the matching intrinsic for seeds to preserve baseline semantics.

The MAX_EXTEND=3.33 culling (radius = ceil(3.33*sqrt(cov))) bounds |x| per gaussian, so the quadratic's domain per (gaussian,row) is bounded and the multiplicative scan over 16 steps stays numerically well-conditioned.

Forward early-exit (tile_done / MIN_TRANSPARENCY) and the per-gaussian alpha-cull branch (ok_mask) are per-pixel and must remain; QSCAN only changes HOW alpha is computed, not WHEN the branch fires (gamma guard handles near-threshold lanes).
